As Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, the field precedent for 1 tonne is the Ecofrost solar cold room holding 4 to 10 degrees Celsius with 5 kilowatt standalone solar and up to 30 hours batteryless backup (E16 Ecofrost - Solar Powered Cold Storage Room Manufacturer in India - Ecozen | Ecozensolutions), matched by the 3 metre by 3 metre by 2 metre ColdHubs store for up to 3 tonnes (E18 Cold Hubs | Engineering For Change), which together mean a small Direct Current (DC, battery-type power) variable-speed vapor-compression monoblock with forced air. In plain words the room must hold the cold against leaks plus cool each day's warm harvest, where product plus respiration heat is a named load (E21 Assessing the Thermal Load of Low-Cost Cold Storage for Perishable Agricultural Products Used in Rural Areas of Bangladesh) with sensible cooling plus respiration (E22 Heat Load Calculation). Solar Energy Systems Engineer, the full-tonne sensible heat from 30 to 5 degrees Celsius is 25.0 kilowatt-hour in the recomputed pull-down estimate (E26), about two households' daily use so it cannot be done in one sun-day, staged as 250 kilogram per day it is 6.20 kilowatt-hour per batch with combined average about 615 watt and 9.70 hour pull at 750 watt cooling in the revised steady-load simulation (E28).

In plain words thick foam plus a strip curtain keeps the leak below the harvest heat, Enclosure and Structural Designer. Polyurethane (PU, foam insulation) 120 millimetre gives heat-transfer coefficient about 0.210 watt per square metre kelvin for about 194 watt transmission at 43 ambient minus 5 room, door gain about 70.0 watt averaged with curtain and 8 openings per day, respiration about 50.0 watt and fans about 40.0 watt in that simulation (E28), shown as high rear evaporator blowing forward over vented crates with low rear return in the side-view sketch (E30), sensed by return-air plus produce probe with 2 kelvin hysteresis.

In plain words propane cools slightly better but is flammable and needs a purpose-built sealed shop while the older gas is non-flammable and any technician can service it, Manager. R134a (tetrafluoroethane, synthetic refrigerant) is A1 non-flammable simplifying handling and service while R290 (propane, natural refrigerant) is A3 highly flammable requiring specifically engineered limited charges and sealed electrics (E17 R134a vs. R290 Refrigerant: Key Differences & Replacements), test work shows R290 Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling heat per electric work) only 2.42 percent higher than R134a (E23 A solar powered off-grid air conditioning system with natural refrigerant for residential buildings: A theoretical and experimental evaluation), and the serviceable Direct Current choice is the BD50F-class compressor family (E19 Secop is committed to delivering advanced refrigeration compressors and) detailed in the DC performance tables (E20 Hermetic Compressors for DC Voltage Modern comfort is brought into life when leaving home. As people go mobile, so does food. The excellent performance of the BD series safeguards food preservation), so I favour R134a for village service with a bench test for 43 degree pull-down. I am not ready, because enclosure thickness and loading discipline must confirm the 350 watt steady assumption.
